title: Workbench AI helper instruction set (v0, draft)
description: One named, versioned instruction set for the Developer Workbench AI helper. Extends haven.workbench-assistant-profile.v0 (PDD_spillverksted_2026-10-09/contract) with editable instruction text and versions. Purposes: purpose://candidate.workbench-ai-helper.instructions.editable, .multiple-sets, .versioned, .limits-per-set. The instruction text never grants access: allowedActions and escalationCeiling are not derived from it, and the target cell re-checks access on every call.

id.description: Stable ASCII id, English, e.g. current-surface.

title.description: Display title in the owner's language, e.g. «Denne flaten».

owner.description: Identity uuid of the owner. Sets are owner-only in v0 (FORMAALSSPEC §6 question 2, default answer). Only the owner may read, edit or revert.

profile.description: The workbench-assistant profile this set runs under. allowedActions, escalationCeiling and audience come from here and are fixed by the surface, not by the instruction text.

scope.description: Which of the four kinds of work the set is for (branches C, B, D, E).

instructions.description: Editable instruction and prompt text. Sent to the model as guidance only. Never parsed for actions, endpoints or permissions.

version.description: Version currently in use. Every save creates a new version.

versions.description: Append-only history. Reverting creates a new version whose text equals an earlier one; nothing is deleted.

author.description: Identity uuid. In v0 always the owner.

revertedFrom.description: Set when this version restores an earlier one.

butler.description: purpose://candidate.butler.always-reachable and purpose://candidate.workbench-ai-helper.butler.handoff. Cannot be switched off by the owner or the text.

sends.description: What Butler gets when the owner hands a case over. Shown to the owner before sending.
